A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
YAGO2 provides the largest knowledge base to date that is both comprehensive in terms of the amount of knowledge and expressive with regard to its spatio-temporal representation.
we have built a large knowledge base with temporal and spatial information, that can be queried in time and space.

The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to automatically extract a rich spatio-temporal ontology from unstructured text, and to use this ontology as a foundation to build a large knowledge base.

the automatic construction of a knowledge base can be extended from a simple fact extraction to an integration of heterogeneous knowledge bases, which is a crucial step towards the vision of the Semantic Web.

the combination of large-scale knowledge bases and advanced query languages enables a wide variety of applications in areas such as information retrieval, question-answering, natural language processing and data mining.
